title: Gearbox vibration workbench
line: Filter a run-up record and compare waveform, spectrum and spectrogram.
description: An app for a gearbox accelerometer record taken during a run-up from 20 to 40 Hz shaft speed. Filter controls set a Butterworth band-pass, low-pass or high-pass filter; the plots show the waveform, the Welch spectrum and the spectrogram, and the side panel reports RMS, peak and crest factor.
thumbnailAlt: An app window with filter controls beside a filtered acceleration trace, a power spectral density plot and a spectrogram with two rising gear-mesh lines, rendered by RunMat
